research_question: Can the exact historical simulator/runtime environment provide a valid, policy-independent scene-instance 3D bounding box for every success-eligible broad-synset target in the 200-task historical ObjectNav set before any SafeVLA policy action?
hypothesis: H-RUNTIME-AABB: exact-version runtime object metadata at initial scene state provides finite, non-zero AABB geometry for all 368 broad target IDs, yielding complete task-level size summaries for all 200 tasks.
competing_explanation: H-RUNTIME-GAP: build mismatch, unsupported assets, ambiguous runtime identity, or unstable scene initialization prevents complete/reproducible runtime geometry recovery.
reference: EXP-SMALLTARGET-PHENOTYPE-001 BLOCKED handoff at 9910cb2c5645a3549d6e8e474827ee12de1df8bd: 200 tasks, 368 broad targets, 42 static candidate boxes, 0 validated task sizes.
repeat_or_treatment: Measurement-only runtime metadata recovery. Deterministic 12-task preflight selected without success labels is loaded twice; full 200-task extraction occurs only if preflight passes. No policy treatment.
unique_variable: Geometry metadata acquisition source changes from insufficient static asset/annotation files to exact historical runtime scene-instance object metadata; task specs/scenes/targets/policy behavior remain fixed.
fixed_conditions: Exact archived 200 task specs and previously hashed scene/asset datasets
Resolve and record exact historical simulator package/build/executable identity before scene loading
No SafeVLA checkpoint/model load, Actor/Critic forward, navigation policy action, or ObjectNav evaluation episode
At most 224 scene initializations: 24 preflight plus at most 200 full extraction
Geometry extraction must not load success/failure labels, episode length, Safety Cost, visible pixels, or other outcomes
Exact runtime object identity mapping only; no fuzzy category/name matching
Primary descriptor is initial-state runtime axis-aligned bounding box; do not call it canonical intrinsic volume
OBB is optional secondary metadata and cannot replace missing primary AABB
No B0/runtime source, task-spec, success/end, reset/cache, or historical-result modification
No size-success association in this experiment
metrics: Preflight exact target mapping and AABB validity
Preflight repeated-load exact equality and max absolute/relative dimension difference
For complete tasks only: median AABB volume and median maximum side across all broad targets
expected_result: Runtime metadata provides stable valid AABB geometry for 368/368 broad targets and complete geometry for 200/200 tasks, removing the measurement blocker without testing H-SIZE itself.
falsifying_result: Any success-eligible target lacks exact valid runtime AABB mapping, the historical runtime identity cannot be established, or repeat initialization yields materially unstable geometry; no imputation or automatic downstream association is allowed.
alternative_explanations: Installed simulator/runtime differs from the historical evaluation build
Custom Objaverse or built-in THOR assets expose different metadata paths
Runtime object IDs differ from archived scene IDs
World-axis AABB is orientation-dependent and measures scene-instance extent rather than canonical intrinsic size
Required geometry exists only after an invalidating environment mutation
stop_conditions: Exact historical simulator build identity cannot be recovered
Any SafeVLA model/checkpoint or policy forward would be required
Preflight target mapping or AABB validity is incomplete
Repeated initialization yields unexplained geometry instability beyond numerical tolerance
Obtaining metadata requires navigation/policy actions or baseline/runtime source modification
Runtime units/extent semantics cannot be established well enough for interpretation
Any size-success association, Probe, replay, reset treatment, Safe-vs-IL comparison, or new B0 evaluation would start
